Read the positive side of the intercept

question: The graph of the linear function \(y=2x+4\) intersects the x-axis at \((-2,0)\), and \(y\) increases as \(x\) increases. The solution set of the inequality \(2x+4>0\) is ( ).
solution: \(y>0\) corresponds to the graph being above the x-axis. Since \(y\) increases as \(x\) increases, this occurs to the right of the intersection, that is, \(x>-2\).
